faq: Is the theme included in the price?
Free themes are included. If a paid theme fits better, we tell you its license price first, and you buy it in your own name so the license is yours.
Will my store look just like the demo?
Close, but with your own logo, colors and photos. Demo stores use stock images, so the final look depends on your product pictures, which we help you prepare.
Can I choose my own theme?
Yes. Send a link and we check that it is fast, kept up to date and works well with WooCommerce. If not, we explain why and suggest alternatives.
What if I need bigger changes later?
Small edits you can do in the editor. For bigger changes, our theme edits service works in a child theme, so theme updates do not undo anything.
